dataset_metadata.name: Aging matrix visualizes complexity of battery aging across hundreds of cycling protocols
dataset_metadata.citation: B. van Vlijmen et al., Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18, 6641-6654. DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05609D
dataset_metadata.funding: Toyota Research Institute (Accelerated Materials Design and Discovery program); National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship; Stanford Data Science Scholars Program; U.S. Department of Defense National Defense Science & Engineering Graduate Fellowship Program

cell_info.cell_notes: Li(Ni,Co,Al)O2/graphite + SiOx cylindrical 21700 cells. Anode contains silicon oxide (SiOx) in addition to graphite.

aging_modes.notes: 207 unique cycling protocols spanning diverse voltage windows and C-rates. EOL defined as 0.2C RPT capacity reaching 80% of 4.84 Ah nominal capacity (3.872 Ah). EFCs at EOL range from 44 to 994. Cycled over 2 years.

time_protocol.notes: Diagnostic cycle performed every 100 aging cycles. Total raw cycles up to 4641 (or up to 994 EFC). Temperature not varied; all cells cycled at 25°C chamber set point. CV hold duration varied from 30 to 90 min (t_CV). Two-step CC charge: CC1 (0.2-2C) followed by CC2 (0.2-1C), with CC_discharge (0.2-3C), V_charge (3.7-4.2V), V_discharge (2.7-3.7V).

rawdata.data_quality_notes: Raw data structured via the BEEP pipeline. Separate raw (V/I timeseries) and summary (capacity, resistance) files provided.

checkup.notes: Diagnostic cycle consists of: reset cycle, HPPC, and three rate reference performance tests (RPT) at 0.2C, 1C, and 2C discharge currents. Resistances reported at 50% SOC by default. Diagnostic cycle applied every 100 aging cycles throughout cell lifetime.

notes: Dataset accompanies the paper introducing an 'aging matrix' framework combining interpretable ML (random forest + SHAP) with 16 mechanistic SOH metrics to visualize battery degradation across 207 cycling protocols. Six cycling parameters are varied: CC1 (first-step charge C-rate, 0.2-2C), CC2 (second-step charge C-rate, 0.2-1C), CC_discharge (0.2-3C), V_charge (3.7-4.2V), V_discharge (2.7-3.7V), t_CV (CV hold time, 30-90 min). Mechanistic SOH metrics include cell-level performance metrics, electrode-specific capacities/SOCs (via DVF algorithm), and trajectory metrics (knee indicator, resistance growth factor, NP ratio). Code available at https://data.matr.io/11/ and https://github.com/viveklam/Joule-Decade-Calendar-Aging. Patent filed: US Application No. 20220137149A1 (15 May 2022).
